context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Two contact sheets, each 48 frames (6x8, chronological) from a Tesla Sentry FRONT camera recorded by the owner's own car during a deliberate door-ding test. Image 1 = event doording-onepass-prod; Image 2 = doording-test-aug13. For EACH, decide whether anything physically touches the recording car anywhere in the clip. Output one line per image:
<event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what>; MOMENT=<approx second>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 15 words>
response:
doording-onepass-prod: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=adjacent car’s open door; MOMENT=unknown; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Door approaches recording car, but contact point is not visible; timestamps unavailable.
doording-test-aug13: VERDICT=unclear; ACTOR=adjacent car’s open door; MOMENT=unknown; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Door approaches recording car, but contact point is not visible; timestamps unavailable.
